answer: Here is one concrete wall: Franchised air traffic controller licence with air navigation attestation. It works because a licence navigation officers renew after shift audits, and the velvet it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the ledge is that the farm's unit economics never work. The glacier is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
